#!/bin/sh #set -eux
# docker container run -d -u root --name jenkins -p 8080:8080 -p 50000:50000 -e JAVA_OPTS="-Duser.timezone=Asia/Taipei" -v C:\docker\jenkins_data:/var/jenkins_home -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock everett6802/jenkins:2.2 # Jenkins mount the folder in the local host: C:\docker\jenkins_data #HOST_DATA_PATH="/host_mnt/c/docker/jenkins_data" #HOST_EXPORT_PATH="/host_mnt/c/docker/jenkins_job_config" #HOST_EXPORT_DIR=${HOST_DATA_PATH} #LOCAL=Asia/Taipei #DATE=$(TZ=$LOCAL date +%Y%m%d_%H%M)
echo "開始匯出 Jenkins Job 設定 執行前請確認：" #echo " 1. 已建立 C:\docker\jenkins_job_config" echo " 1. 已建立 ${HOST_EXPORT_PATH}" echo " 2. 已放入 export_job_config.sh，並使用 LF 換行"
# docker container run --rm -v "${HOST_DATA_PATH}:/data:ro" -v "${HOST_EXPORT_PATH}:/export" alpine:3.18 sh /export/export_job_config.sh --src /data/jobs --dst /export/jobs # 這裡改用 --mount：來源資料夾不存在時，Docker 會直接報錯，比 -v 自動建立空資料夾更容易發現路徑設定錯誤 docker container run --rm \ --mount "type=bind,source=${HOST_DATA_PATH},target=/data,readonly" \ --mount "type=bind,source=${HOST_EXPORT_PATH},target=/export" \ alpine:3.18 sh -ec ' if [ ! -f /export/export_job_config.sh ]; then echo "ERROR: 找不到 /export/export_job_config.sh" >&2 exit 1 fi if [ ! -d /data/jobs ]; then echo "ERROR: 找不到 /data/jobs，請檢查 Jenkins 資料掛載路徑。" >&2 exit 1 fi sh /export/export_job_config.sh --src /data/jobs --dst /export/jobs ' echo "Jenkins Job 設定匯出完成"
